$ corvex plan --help

--- stdout ---
Invoke the Planner agent (read-only) to analyze spec.md and generate a DAG of tasks.

Usage:
  corvex plan <project> [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help       help for plan
      --here       plan from the current directory even when a worktree exists for this project
      --reanchor   accept the current spec.md as-is: update the stored spec hash without invoking the Planner or touching tasks.md (use when a spec edit doesn't change the task breakdown)

Global Flags:
      --no-color   Disable color output
  -q, --quiet      Suppress per-task progress; print only failures/errors and the final summary

--- stderr ---
(empty)

--- error ---
(nil)
